classes.A: character close / medium, final tier at 100 % scale
classes.B: wide / environment / prop insert with no head over 0.10 of the frame width, final tier at 75 %
classes.C1: drawn 2D full frame, no Cycles render
classes.C2: re-uses a hook shot's staging code (S08 jaws, S09 gauge macro, S24 crane), final tier 75 %, 4 spp

sets.X1: v11 expressway, the hook's rescue zone as built (wreck, rescue truck, work lamp, jam, skyline). Existing.
sets.X1s: X1 plus the overturned sedan 40 D behind the truck, placed where no hook camera (S03-S05, S24) sees it. Dressing of the existing set.
sets.X2: The same expressway model 150 D further on: jack-knifed lorry across the lanes, service-stair gate at the left barrier, a taxi against the truck's left side. Dressing of the existing set + two new props.
sets.X2c: X2 at the truck: exterior shots that need the cab door, windscreen and the people inside (cab shell from CAB).
sets.CAB: NEW: rescue truck crew cab interior (two front seats, rear bench, console with the siren switch, windows) and the equipment wall with roll shutter and dressed shelves.
sets.UND: NEW: service stair on a pier and the street under the expressway (piers, puddles, rain curtains at the deck edges).
sets.BUS: NEW, one shot: a bus window panel with wet glass and moving lights. Fallback: replace S130 with a phone screen (C1).
sets.RIV: NEW: riverside block, hospital side: steel gate, forecourt, lit facade, river.
sets.SITE: NEW: riverside block, building-site side: hoarding with a bent panel, bare concrete hall with columns. Same file as RIV.
sets.2D: Drawn full frame in SVG, composited in finish.py. No Blender.
